Name: Poppi's Kawaii Valley
Author: PoppiPan
Description:
[b]UPDATED VERSION!!
Only one problem remains: apparently Json Assets resets all items when you leave the game and restart it. For this reason, I recommend that you empty all machines and have nothing in progress when you quit (it's my only solution for now, sorry!)

REQUIRED: Custom Farming Redux, Json Assets, Artisan Valley, More Trees, More Food, and Fruits and Veggies![/b]

[u]INSTALLATION[/u]:
([u][b][size=4]follow the README instructions[/size][/b][/u])
-Place the CustomFarmingRedux folders into the Mods>CustomFarmingRedux>Machines folder
-Place the [JA] folder directly into Mods
